overview: This enum sets the small rank marks shown inside a main rank group.

None.technical: FGameDataTableRow_RankPoint defaults this field to None. SetRank passes it to UGamePlayerRankGradeWidget::SetGrade, where it is below every mapped key and leaves all four grade marks collapsed. The rank manual also passes None when it shows a class header without a selected grade.

Vermilion.simple: The lowest grade step, which shows no small marks.
Vermilion.technical: It sits below Bronze in the enum order. SetGrade tests each mapped mark with Grade >= Key, so a Vermilion rank leaves Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum collapsed. The rank manual sorts class rows descending by this byte, placing Vermilion rows after higher grades.

Bronze.simple: One small rank mark is shown.
Bronze.technical: InitializeWidget maps Bronze to GradeMarkImage_1. SetGrade shows that mark when the grade is at least Bronze, so a Bronze rank displays the first mark.

Silver.simple: Two small rank marks are shown.
Silver.technical: InitializeWidget maps Silver to GradeMarkImage_2. SetGrade shows both Bronze and Silver marks when the grade is at least Silver, so a Silver rank displays the first two marks.

Gold.simple: Three small rank marks are shown.
Gold.technical: InitializeWidget maps Gold to GradeMarkImage_3. SetGrade shows Bronze, Silver and Gold marks when the grade is at least Gold, so a Gold rank displays the first three marks.

Platinum.simple: All four small rank marks are shown.
Platinum.technical: InitializeWidget maps Platinum to GradeMarkImage_4. SetGrade shows every mapped mark when the grade is at least Platinum, so a Platinum rank displays all four marks.

Invalid.simple: This value marks an invalid rank grade.
Invalid.technical: The enum declares it with value 255. No traced consumer or exported RankPointDataTable row uses it, so its display behavior is unknown.

notes: Grade marks are cumulative. SetGrade uses Grade >= Key for Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum.
Vermilion and None fall below Bronze and show no marks in that widget.
The rank manual sorts class rows descending by RankPointGrade, so Platinum rows appear before lower grades within the same class.
KPI rows cast the grade to uint8 and record it as a string. Without a found rank row the recorded grade is 0.
Only SPECIAL_GRADE_01 uses None in the exported rank rows. Invalid does not occur.
